::: {.dynamic .horizontal header="🕹️ Simulation Interactive : Interpolation dans l'Espace Latent (AE vs VAE)"}

::: {.controls header="Modèle"}
Sélectionnez l'architecture et naviguez directement dans l'espace mathématique en faisant glisser le curseur.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// 1. Toggle pour choisir entre AE et VAE
viewof modeVAE = ui.toggle({
  label: "Modèle",
  options: {
    "ae": "AE",
    "vae": "VAE"
  },
  states: {
    "ae": "danger",
    "vae": "success"
  },
  value: "ae"
})
```

:::

::: {.render .transparent .flex-grow-2 header="Espace Latent 2D (AE vs VAE)"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// 1. Initialisation du Canvas avec l'architecture atomique
viewof latentPos = {
  window.d3 = window.d3 || d3; 
  // On utilise 'width' (réactif Observable) pour un rendu 1:1 natif
  const canvas = ui.canvas({ width: width, height: 400, shadow: true });
  const svg = d3.select(canvas.node);

  // Dragging logic
  svg.call(d3.drag()
    .on("drag", (event) => {
      const [mx, my] = d3.pointer(event, canvas.node);
      const x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width, mx));
      const y = Math.max(0, Math.min(400, my));
      canvas.node.value = {x, y};
      canvas.node.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input"));
    })
  );

  canvas.node.__canvas = canvas;
  canvas.node.value = {x: width / 2, y: 200};
  return canvas.node;
}

// 2. Mise à jour réactive des composants (Nodes & Auras)
_updateLatent2D = {
  window.d3 = window.d3 || d3;
  const pos = latentPos;
  const mode = modeVAE;
  const canvasElement = viewof latentPos;
  if (!canvasElement.__canvas) return;
  const canvas = canvasElement.__canvas;

  // Réinitialisation propre de la couche principale
  d3.select(canvas.mainNode).selectAll("*").remove();

  // Positions relatives (1/4 et 3/4 de la largeur) pour garder l'aspect ratio visuel
  const pA = {x: width * 0.25, y: 200}, pB = {x: width * 0.75, y: 200};
  const isVae = mode === "vae";
  const auraType = isVae ? "gradient" : "solid";
  const auraRad = isVae ? 220 : 60;
  const auraOp = isVae ? 0.35 : 0.15;

  // Liaison
  canvas.atom.link({ source: pA, target: pB, dashed: true, color: theme.base01, width: 4 });

  // Nœud Chat
  canvas.atom.node({ 
    x: pA.x, y: pA.y, 
    radius: 35,
    color: theme.blue, 
    label: "Chat",
    aura: auraType,
    auraRadius: auraRad,
    auraOpacity: auraOp
  });

  // Nœud Chien
  canvas.atom.node({ 
    x: pB.x, y: pB.y, 
    radius: 35,
    color: theme.red, 
    label: "Chien",
    aura: auraType,
    auraRadius: auraRad,
    auraOpacity: auraOp
  });

  // Nœud Curseur
  const cursorNode = canvas.atom.node({ 
    x: pos.x, y: pos.y, 
    color: theme.yellow, 
    radius: 15,
    aura: "solid",
    auraRadius: 30,
    auraOpacity: 0.3
  });
  cursorNode.style("cursor", "grab");
}

// 3. Calcul de l'alpha consolidé pour le rendu final
alphaLatent = {
  const pos = latentPos;
  const pA = {x: width * 0.25, y: 200}, pB = {x: width * 0.75, y: 200};
  const dA = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(pos.x - pA.x, 2) + Math.pow(pos.y - pA.y, 2));
  const dB = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(pos.x - pB.x, 2) + Math.pow(pos.y - pB.y, 2));

  return dA / (dA + dB);
}
```

::: {.render header="Sortie"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Générateur du résultat en fonction de la position et de l'architecture
{
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100%; padding: 10px;";

  let emoji = "";
  let confidence = 0;
  let textOut = "";
  let isGlitch = false;

  if (modeVAE === "vae") {
    // Logique VAE : Interpolation douce (Confidence & Labels)
    confidence = 0.85 + (Math.abs(alphaLatent - 0.5) * 0.3);
    if (alphaLatent < 0.2) textOut = "Concept : Chat";
    else if (alphaLatent > 0.8) textOut = "Concept : Chien";
    else textOut = "Espace Latent : Transition Cohérente";
  } else {
    // Logique AE classique : Chute brutale de cohérence au milieu
    if (alphaLatent < 0.15) {
      emoji = "🐱"; textOut = "Chat"; confidence = 0.98;
    } else if (alphaLatent > 0.85) {
      emoji = "🐶"; textOut = "Chien"; confidence = 0.98;
    } else {
      isGlitch = true;
      confidence = Math.max(0, 1 - (Math.abs(alphaLatent - 0.5) * 5)); // Chute drastique vers 0
      textOut = "ERREUR: Point mort dans l'espace";
    }
  }

  // Effet "Glitch" (Bruit latent) pour l'AE au milieu
  if (isGlitch) {
    const glitches = ["🤡", "🤖", "👽", "👻", "👹", "👺", "🌚", "🌝", "👾", "💩", "🦄", "🧟", "🧠", "🐷", "🐸", "🐵", "🐔", "🐨", "🐯", "🐮", "🐧", "🤪", "😵", "🧐"];
    emoji = glitches[Math.floor(Math.random() * glitches.length)];
  }

  // Rendu UI
  const displayEmoji = document.createElement("div");
  displayEmoji.style.cssText = `font-size: 4em; height: 1.2em; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; position: relative; filter: ${isGlitch ? 'hue-rotate(90deg) blur(2px)' : 'none'}`;

  if (modeVAE === "vae") {
    // Cross-fade triple pour une transition fluide (Chat -> Fox -> Chien)
    const createLayer = (txt, op) => {
      const span = document.createElement("span");
      span.innerText = txt;
      span.style.cssText = `position: absolute; opacity: ${op}; transition: opacity 0.1s;`;
      return span;
    };

    let opCat = 0, opFox = 0, opDog = 0;
    if (alphaLatent <= 0.5) {
      opCat = 1 - (alphaLatent * 2);
      opFox = alphaLatent * 2;
    } else {
      opFox = 1 - ((alphaLatent - 0.5) * 2);
      opDog = (alphaLatent - 0.5) * 2;
    }

    displayEmoji.appendChild(createLayer("🐱", opCat));
    displayEmoji.appendChild(createLayer("🦊", opFox));
    displayEmoji.appendChild(createLayer("🐶", opDog));
  } else {
    displayEmoji.innerText = emoji;
  }

  const desc = document.createElement("div");
  desc.style.cssText = `font-family: monospace; font-size: 1.5em; margin-top: 15px; color: ${isGlitch ? theme.red : theme.cyan}; font-weight: bold;`;
  desc.innerText = textOut;

  // Jauge de cohérence mathématique
  const meterCont = document.createElement("div");
  meterCont.style.cssText = `width: 100%; background: ${theme.base2}; height: 16px; border-radius: 8px; margin-top: 25px; overflow: hidden;`;
  const fill = document.createElement("div");
  fill.style.cssText = `width: ${confidence * 100}%; height: 100%; background: ${confidence > 0.5 ? theme.green : theme.red}; transition: width 0.3s;`;
  meterCont.appendChild(fill);

  const meterLabel = document.createElement("div");
  meterLabel.style.cssText = `font-size: 1.1em; color: theme.base03; margin-top: 10px; font-weight: 600;`;
  meterLabel.innerText = `Cohérence sémantique : ${(confidence * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;

  container.appendChild(displayEmoji);
  container.appendChild(desc);
  container.appendChild(meterCont);
  container.appendChild(meterLabel);

  return container;
}
```
